text:
Miriam: Quick sync — vendor asked for a joint go-to-market window for H200 + Gaudi marketplace listings. Can we map dependencies? :calendar:
Ken: timeline first: vendor proposes week of May 13 for embargo lift, internal PR week of May 20, marketplace listing live May 21. Is that still doable?
Raj: technically H200 perf tests + mi300 regressions need final gates by May 10 to be safe. We still have one kv-cache regression open.
Carla: SI partners also want a 2-week lead to finish integrations (AKS images + docs). That pushes our safe announce to May 27 if we give them time.
Miriam: Noted. So three constraints: vendor embargo, eng gating, SI onramp. We should pick a single public announce that meets all.
Sam: Platform needs to bake images and marketplace manifests. ETA for image builds: May 9 if lab queue stays clear. I can add burst capacity but need approval.
Ken: Approve burst for images if it shaves more than 3 days. Carla — can SI sign off earlier if we provide pre-release artifacts / feature flags?
Carla: Some SIs can start earlier with a preprod image + churn doc, yes. But others (regulated customers) require final signed firmware/hardware docs which they won't accept until vendor final sign-off. Mixed bag.
Raj: Proposal: we aim for internal PR May 17, allow SI staggered access May 10-24, public announce May 24. That gives eng one week after image builds for final validation.
Miriam: That looks like a reasonable compromise. Action items: 1) Sam request burst for May 7-10; 2) Raj triage kv-cache regression and target fix by May 8; 3) Carla to split SI list into "early" + "late" and notify early with preprod artifacts on May 11.
Sam: Requesting burst now — added ticket: #PLATFORM-8892. Deploy-bot: build pipeline for gaudi-h200-image triggered.
deploy-bot: [CI] pipeline queued: gaudi-h200-image (build-4521). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4521
Ken: Marketing + PR — please hold public embargo copy until May 21 internal PR sign-off. We'll run canary release on May 22 for 24-hour soak.
Carla: I'll send SI segmentation doc by EOD. For SIs that need firmware docs, who owns vendor sign-off? Miriam?
Miriam: I'll own vendor comms. Reaching out today to pin exact embargo text and firmware deliverables.
Raj: One more tech note — Mi300 variant requires updated quantization recipe in prod. I'll submit config diff: `qconfig_v2.json` in the repo by EOD.
Ken: Great. Let's reconvene next Wednesday 10am PT if there are material changes. If anyone hits blockers ping @miriam and I'll escalate to vendor. :+1:
Miriam: Thanks everyone — I'll summarize tasks in the partnership tracker and post the vendor draft when available.
